description.zh: 比较是一种基于共同维度，对两个或多个对象进行关系判断、差异识别、顺序定位或等同性确认的元思维操作。
description.en: Comparison is a meta-thinking operation that uses shared dimensions to judge relations, identify differences, locate order, or confirm equivalence among two or more objects.

ageRange.noteZh: 覆盖 4-5 岁到小学毕业阶段。
ageRange.noteEn: Covers ages 4-5 through primary school graduation.

educationReference.policyZh: 以全球基础教育大纲和教材为知识背景，不增加额外知识负担，以知识内容承载思维训练。
educationReference.policyEn: Uses global K-12 foundational curricula as background knowledge without adding extra knowledge burden; domain content is used as a carrier for thinking training.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在单一感知维度上做直接比较（大/小、多/少、长/短）。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Perform direct comparison on a single perceptual dimension.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在 10 以内进行数量与图示对应比较。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Compare quantities within 10 using symbol-visual correspondence.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在 20 以内进行直接比较与接近判断。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Perform direct and proximity comparison within 20.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 引入双维比较（如数量+长度），进行基础排序。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Introduce dual-dimension comparison and basic ranking.
levelMap.coverageGapZh: 多属性比较已实现（multi_attribute），限时比较小游戏两种玩法均已覆盖（mini: quick_compare 快速比较 / build_time 限时搭塔，后者按序取最长/最短，是排序能力的入口）。仍缺自由拖放排序活动（sort runtime）。
levelMap.coverageGapEn: Multi-attribute comparison is implemented, and both timed mini-game engines are available (mini: quick_compare and build_time, the latter picking longest/shortest in order as an entry point to ranking). Free drag-to-sort activities (sort runtime) are still missing.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 进行间接与链式比较（A>B, B>C 推导 A>C）。
在多维标准下比较并说明取舍理由。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Compare under multi-criteria and explain trade-offs.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 比较策略效率与条件充分性，形成可解释判断。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Compare strategy efficiency and condition sufficiency with explanations.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 比较证据强弱与信息可信度，完成综合判断。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Compare evidence strength and information reliability for integrated judgment.

videos.titleEn: Math Comparison and Number Sense Intro

exercises.descriptionZh: 数值直接比较与接近判断。
exercises.descriptionEn: Direct number comparison and proximity judgment.

exercises.descriptionZh: 通过直观线段长短进行直接比较。
exercises.descriptionEn: Perform direct comparison by visual bar length.

exercises.descriptionZh: 证据充分性与可信度比较。

aggregationRules.ruleZh: avgTimeMs 必须按 game_mode 分桶：puzzle 是单题时长，interaction 是单个活动时长，mini 是整局（12-18 个 round）净时长，三者不可混算。mini 的可比时间指标是 avgRoundMs。
aggregationRules.ruleEn: avgTimeMs MUST be bucketed by game_mode: puzzle is per-question time, interaction is per-activity time, mini is the whole run (12-18 rounds). They are not comparable; for mini use avgRoundMs instead.

aggregationRules.ruleZh: 一个 mini 模板只产生一个 Attempt，权重与一道 puzzle 相同；round 数只存在于 process 中，round 级事件属遥测，不得计为 Attempt。
aggregationRules.ruleEn: A mini template yields exactly one Attempt, weighted like a single puzzle question. Round counts live only in process; round-level events are telemetry and must not be counted as attempts.

aggregationRules.ruleZh: gameEngine 已实现两个取值：quick_compare（左右二选一，一轮一次判断）与 build_time（从递减的一堆里取最长/最短，一轮一次放置）。两者的一轮不是同一件事；errorType 取值相同（perception / polarity_confusion），但同一个标签在两个引擎里指的是不同的失误（前者是「问更少却选了更多」，后者是抓了堆里的另一个极端）。因此 mini 内部仍必须按 gameEngine 分桶，不可只按 game_mode 汇总。
aggregationRules.ruleEn: gameEngine currently has two implemented values: quick_compare (a two-way choice per round) and build_time (taking the longest/shortest from a shrinking pile, one placement per round). A round is different work in each, and although both report the same errorType values (perception / polarity_confusion), the same label denotes a different slip per engine. Metrics inside mini MUST therefore still be bucketed by gameEngine, not pooled by game_mode alone.

statistics.note: eventKeys round_start/round_answer/game_finish are declared for vocabulary stability; phase 1 uploads only the summary Attempt.
